Content inside <template> is never rendered per the HTML spec and must not appear in the output

```dart title="Dart"

import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {

  try {

    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<p>visible</p><template><p>secret template text</p></template><p>also visible</p>', options: options);

    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
